rationale: Three exact original spans preserve the two establishment/investigation and interested-member sentences of section 1-101, and the reporting command in section 1-102. The preamble separately identifies the dispute and invoked statutory framework; it was fully read.

EO12379 section 5 expressly revokes this order. All 25 revoker sections and the signature were read; no deferred effective clause or target savings appears. August 17, 1982 is a supported formal later event and supports the three terminated cutoff states in their EO-command scope.

The original report deadline is not a board termination clause, proof of submission, or proof of completed investigation. Actual submission is not itself an expressly stated automatic EO termination trigger; any such legal effect would require reading the invoked statutes. The candidate does not invent that effect or compute an end date.

Public Law 95-504 section 44 and Railway Labor Act section 10 are expressly invoked and have not been read from held controlling statutory text. The unresolved statutory effect is concrete, and actual completion/report evidence is independently absent from the inspected material. All first_end fields and whole_order_end correctly remain null.

The complete source extracts have matching recorded GPO PDF fixity. No page images or newly retained official PDFs were inspected; absent image review is not independently treated as a legal blocker here.

Independent party/subject searching went beyond order-number indexing, including whitespace-normalized Wien Air Alaska and Wien Alaska Airlines in the held official, source-ladder and opus text directories. Relevant party results were the original and revoker; contexts of unrelated airline notices and regulatory references were assessed. This remains a bounded local search, not historical exhaustion.

The candidate eCFR and OFR searches are acceptable only as bounded later-reference searches. They do not establish the historical reporting event or close the invoked statutory framework. The ten erroneous earlier actor bindings are excluded because their text is EO12379; exclusion is not a full-source review of those ten orders.
